scopeLimitations: The personally viewed selected V2 original-project portrait is internal authority, not external historical proof. No absolute 1:1 certification.
Visible face, cap, braided hair, layered cape/skirt and khipu are qualified; concealed back garment geometry and tiny knot construction remain unknown.
No chronological age is asserted. All scenes are family-safe, fully clothed and non-romantic; CG13 alone swaps gender presentation.
New settings are original compatible Andean high-road, masonry and knotted-memory compositions, not historical religious reconstruction.
The personally opened old atlas is historical mismatch-only: short cream tunic and rust cape, no purple cap, no long skirt and no khipu.
observedIdentity: Bronze-skinned woman with long black braids, purple and gold woven textile cap, gold earrings and large round sun brooch; long purple/navy cape and full long skirt with orange-gold woven geometric borders, orange bodice, woven belts and side leather pouch; brown sandals with purple shin straps. Anatomical RIGHT hand (viewer LEFT) grips/guides the hanging orange/violet/ivory knotted weighted cords below a complete HORIZONTAL wooden khipu support on that side; anatomical LEFT hand (viewer RIGHT) extends additional orange/violet cords. Two ordinary human hands; cords are not fingers. No sword, sling, vertical staff or cream short tunic.
